parameters.content:
## MCP - Chart Generator

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/chart-generator

**Parameters:**
- `data` (required): Chart data - formats supported:
  - Array: [{label: 'A', value: 10}, {label: 'B', value: 20}]
  - Object: {labels: ['A','B'], values: [10,20]}
  - Chart.js: {labels: [...], datasets: [...]}
- `chart_type` (optional): bar | line | pie | doughnut | radar | polarArea (default: bar)
- `title` (optional): Chart title
- `dataset_label` (optional): Dataset label
- `width` (optional): Width in pixels (default: 600)
- `height` (optional): Height in pixels (default: 400)
- `format` (optional): png | svg | webp (default: png)
- `background_color` (optional): Background color (default: white)
- `options.colors` (optional): Array of colors
- `options.show_legend` (optional): Show legend (default: true)

**Returns:** Chart URL and configuration

**Provider:** QuickChart.io (free, no API key required)
